desc_id: Kompleks Candi Arjuna di Dataran Tinggi Dieng adalah salah satu kompleks candi Hindu tertua di Jawa. Candi-candinya diberi nama tokoh wayang, seperti Arjuna, Semar, Srikandi, dan Puntadewa.
desc_en: The Arjuna Temple complex on the Dieng Plateau is one of the oldest Hindu temple complexes in Java. Its temples are named after wayang characters such as Arjuna, Semar, Srikandi and Puntadewa.
